first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also reverse the 6% activation decline, with two inherited records indicating durable early-adoption gains. I would verify those records and compare their downstream quality evidence with promotional pricing, which addresses competitive pressure but may carry greater retention and margin risk. The current intent remains provisional until archive review.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled experiment shortening onboarding. exp_86 directly supports this choice with higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, while exp_31 shows activation and qualified-revenue gains from SMB signup simplification but a small retention decline and limited segment generalizability. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because exp_73 shows severe retention loss before first renewal, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue. Measure completion, activation, qualified revenue, and renewal-oriented retention guardrails by segment.
